ideas.idea: Remove or move the Product JSON-LD on /shop because a listing page with several items is mislabeled as a single Product
ideas.why: /shop lists bilge pumps, cleats and rope, so a single-product 'Bilge pump' schema misdescribes the page, which is specific and accurate.

ideas.idea: Add <main> landmark and a viewport meta tag
ideas.why: The viewport tag is missing from app.html and the content isn't in <main>, but both are standard advice with little effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Give each product its own page with name, price and photo
ideas.why: /shop only mentions products in a single sentence, so separate linkable pages would let people and machines find individual items.

ideas.idea: Add a delivery page explaining cut-off times and regions
ideas.why: The next-day and free-delivery claims have no supporting readable detail, since the delivery notice is data-nosnippet, so a delivery page would answer buyer questions.

ideas.idea: Add og:title and og:description share tags to the home page
ideas.why: Open Graph tags are accurately missing but only affect link previews and apply to almost any site.
/search is deliberately noindex, so a description there is pointless and the report itself says to leave it alone.
